about.title: About Credit Utilization Calculator - Credit Score Impact Tool
about.description: The Credit Utilization Calculator is a comprehensive credit management tool designed to help you understand how your credit card balances affect your credit score and overall creditworthiness. This calculator analyzes your credit utilization ratio across individual cards and overall credit limits, providing recommendations to optimize your credit score. Whether you're planning purchases or managing existing debt, this tool helps maintain healthy credit utilization ratios.

faq.q: What is a good credit utilization ratio?
faq.a: Generally, keep your total credit utilization below 30% for good credit scores, and below 10% for excellent scores. Individual cards should also stay below 30%, with lower ratios being better for your credit score.

faq.q: How does credit utilization affect my credit score?
faq.a: Credit utilization accounts for about 30% of your credit score calculation. High utilization (above 30%) can significantly lower your score, while low utilization (under 10%) helps maintain or improve your score.

faq.q: Should I pay off cards completely or spread balances?
faq.a: It's generally better to pay off high-utilization cards first to reduce individual card ratios. However, having small balances (1-9% utilization) on some cards can be better than having all cards at 0% utilization.

faq.q: When should I make payments to improve utilization?
faq.a: Make payments before your statement closing date to reduce the balance reported to credit bureaus. Most cards report statement balances, not current balances, so timing matters for credit score impact.
